messages.content:
Build an advanced onboarding system for a Smart Study Planner web app using React (with Tailwind CSS for UI).

Current system only has name, email, password.

I want to extend it into a multi-step dynamic onboarding flow:

Step 1: Basic Info
- Name
- Email
- Password

Step 2: User Level Selection
Ask:
"What is your current level?"
Options:
1. School Student
2. College Student
3. Working Professional

Step 3: Purpose Selection
Ask:
"What is your primary goal?"
Options:
- Prepare for Exams
- Learn Skills
- Prepare for Interviews

Step 4: Conditional Inputs Based on Selection

If "School Student":
- Ask class (1 to 12)
- If class is 11 or 12:
  - Ask stream: Science / Commerce / Arts
  - Show subjects accordingly

If "College Student":
- Ask:
  - Course (B.Tech, BSc, BCom, etc.)
  - Branch (CSE, ECE, etc.)
  - Year (1st, 2nd, etc.)

If "Working Professional":
- Ask:
  - Field (IT, Finance, etc.)
  - Experience level

If "Learn Skills":
- Ask:
  - Skill (e.g. Programming, Design, Communication)
- Based on skill:
  - Generate:
    - Learning resources
    - Quiz suggestions
    - Articles

If "Prepare for Exams":
- Ask:
  - Exam type:
    - Government Exams
    - GATE
    - Board Exams
    - Semester Exams
- Based on selection:
  - Generate customized study plan

If "Prepare for Interviews":
- Ask:
  - Role (Software Engineer, Data Analyst, etc.)
- Generate:
  - Interview questions
  - Practice plan

Step 5: Store all user data in state (or backend if available)

Step 6: Dynamic Dashboard
After onboarding, redirect user to a dashboard that changes based on user profile:

Dashboard should include:
- Personalized study plan
- Recommended resources
- Progress tracker
- Quiz section

UI Requirements:
- Use clean modern card layout
- Use Tailwind CSS
- Add step progress indicator
- Make it mobile responsive

Code Requirements:
- Use React functional components
- Use useState / useContext for state management
- Create reusable components for each step
- Use conditional rendering for dynamic forms

Also include:
- Sample JSON structure for storing user profile
- Example logic for generating dashboard content based on user type

Make the code modular and scalable.
